label: private customer RFP and contract corpus (208 documents, 105 cases)
notes: Cases drafted by mistral, reviewed and corrected by an AI assistant (claude), approved by the maintainer; not human-verified case by case.
Calibration grades are an AI assistant's (38 of 40) plus 2 by the maintainer. Human calibration (ROADMAP P2-3) remains open.

Judge v1 overstates answer_correct: bias +0.21 (first sheet, n=14) and +0.30 (quick sheet on corrected references, n=20). Judge v2 is near-unbiased on correct (-0.03, n=20), and scores answer_correct 0.52 on the same answers: the better estimate is that the chat answers correctly about half the time.

Judge v1 also overstates faithfulness (+0.16, n=19); v2 is harsh there (-0.26) and fails to parse 6 of 105 verdicts. v1 is the baseline judge for consistency: use answer_correct and faithfulness to detect regressions, not as absolute quality.
Retrieval metrics do not depend on the judge. Corpus has 64 file names duplicated across folders; source matching is by file name.
